`generated.xgwx` is a synthetic multi-PLC regression container assembled from
library-generated XGK-CPUH, XGK-CPUHN and XGI-CPUE LD defaults. PLCs/programs/tasks
intentionally repeat names and base numbers; GUIDs and program IDs are distinct.
It exercises ownership, selected XGK CPU changes and serializer preservation.
It is not native XG5000 multi-PLC acceptance evidence.
